payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Babulus
payload.description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the audit of Babulus (main), one checklist line each.

**Evidence / Fix** (checklist)
- [ ] The shared footer links Biblicus, which returns 404 (anthus-footer); fix the link.
- [ ] /docs/config-setup links github.com/anthropics/babulus/issues, which returns 404 (config-setup.ts:8); use the AnthusAI repository URL.
- [ ] README says Node 18+ but .nvmrc is 22.12.0 (README.md:8 vs :95), and the README has no Studio section.
- [ ] /dashboard uses the generic title pattern; give it a specific page title.

**How to verify**
Each box is checked by visiting the URL named in it, or `grep -n 'Node.js 18' README.md` returns nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
